description: Combine several PDFs into one, in the order given. Each entry can be a file (path or base64) or {file, pages} to take only some pages ("1-3, 5, 8-"; "3-1" keeps reverse order; a page can repeat). Password-protected PDFs must be unlocked first. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-merge/

files.description: PDFs to merge, in order: a path/base64 string, or {file, pages}.

anyOf.description: The PDF: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

file.description: The PDF: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

pages.description: Pages to take from this file, e.g. "1-3, 5, 8-" or "3-1" (reversed). Empty = all.

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

name: pdf_merge
title: Merge PDFs
